evidence_spans: For the components assigned to n = 7 and n = 8 in the wider device, the FWHM-normalized peak separation is RFWHM7,8 = 2.15
For Device B, the components assigned to n = 7 and n = 8 give RFWHM7,8 = 2.15 ± 0.03
Device B has a width of 6 .4 ¸ tm.
For the components assigned to n = 7 and n = 8 in the wider device, the FWHM-normalized peak separation is RFWHM7,8 = 2.15
Measurements of photon-number-dependent time-of-arrival (TOA) distributions in wide NbN superconducting microstrip single-photon detectors (SMSPDs) are presented.
CLM-DEV-0080.statement: For components assigned to n = 7 and n = 8 in Device B, the FWHM-normalized peak separation RFWHM7,8 is 2.15 ± 0.03.

extra_quotes: Two 10 ¸ tm-long devices with widths of 3.2 ¸ tm and 6.4 ¸ tm are characterized under pulsed 515 nm excitation.
The TOA histograms are described by sums of exponentially modiﬁed Gaussian (EMG) components
The devices were mounted on the cold stage of a cryogenic system and operated at 6 K.
TOA histograms were recorded with a 4 ps time bin.
